intro.title: FUNDA — Smart Login Form
intro.body: In this lesson you will build a Smart Login Form with email and password fields, real-time validation feedback, async email-existence checking, and double-submit prevention. You will use Reactive Forms with custom sync validators for password strength and a custom async validator that calls an API to check if an email is registered. The submit button uses exhaustMap to ignore repeated clicks while the login request is in flight. Error messages appear inline as the user interacts, following Angular's touched and dirty state model for polished UX.
intro.usecase: Authentication forms are the entry point of virtually every web application. In senior interviews you will be asked to explain the difference between sync and async validators, how to avoid flickering validation messages, and how exhaustMap prevents race conditions on form submission.
